misprints.note: Printed with ξ. The next form, Ἀμαζονίς, has ζ.
The accent is printed on the ί, not on the ό.
The headword is printed with i.
Printed with π twice. The entry glosses it as breathing in (in).
Printed with φ: the letter has the same shape as the φ in φρένες on the same strip.
The n is printed turned, so it reads as u.
Printed with no comma after 'a.'. The abbreviation 'dna' (denna) is as printed.

uncertain.note: The diaeresis on the ι is hard to see. The glyph shows a tall stroke above it.
The breathing could be rough or smooth. I wrote rough; the OCR had ἄγιον.

uncertain.text: χαλκῖτις, ιδος. ἡ. / φοινικίς, ιδος, ἡ.
uncertain.note: I see no accent on ιδος in either place, while other ίδος forms on the page have one. I copied ιδος as printed.
τό is printed with an acute where a grave is expected. I kept it as printed.
